changes.reason: HTTP shutdown defers diagnostic sink failures until cleanup finishes and preserves lifecycle failures. Reuses the existing Node listener, event drain and hook deadline.

kubernetes.reason: Reuses the existing Node shutdown controller; focused controller tests do not certify a deployed host.
constraints: Existing total deadline and event-drain cap remain in force; no live infrastructure or provider certification.

aws-lambda.reason: Explicit controller shutdown shares this behavior; automatic process signal registration remains disabled in Lambda. No live invocation verification.
constraints: Existing total deadline and event-drain cap remain in force; no live infrastructure or provider certification.

cloudflare.reason: This controller owns Node process signals and Node listeners. Workers use a separate fetch transport.
constraints: No Worker isolate or Node Container support is introduced.
